tldr: Venus in the 6th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward work, health, and routine
body: Venus in the 6th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward work, health, and routine. Gift: ease and charm there. Watch: indulgence or avoidance. With Venus in the 6th house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through daily work, health, habits, service, maintenance, and labor. This makes how your days are built and whether your routine supports the life you say you want a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through rhythm and service.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in rhythm and service.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
